title: Prompt Manifest
description: Metadata and file references for a reusable workshop prompt or prompt-chain stage.

version.description: Semantic version of the prompt asset.

lab.description: Lab identifier this prompt belongs to (e.g. 01-explicit-contract).

variant.description: Which comparison variant this prompt represents.

purpose.description: One-line description of what the prompt accomplishes.

system_prompt.description: Relative path to the system/developer prompt Markdown file. Optional for baseline-only prompts.

user_prompt.description: Relative path to the user prompt Markdown file.

variables.description: Declared template variables. Every declared variable MUST appear in a prompt file, and every placeholder in a prompt file MUST be declared here.

output_schema.description: Relative path to the JSON Schema for structured output. REQUIRED for structured-output prompts.

test_set.description: Relative path to the JSON Lines test set. REQUIRED for every production (improved/reference) variant.

model.description: Supported GPT-5.4 settings only. Unsupported sampling parameters (temperature, top_p, presence_penalty, frequency_penalty) MUST NOT appear.

change_notes.description: REQUIRED when version increments from a prior published version. Describes what/why/motivating failure/tests run/score delta.
